prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, new_screen] Pre-Spawn Pet Behavior Sandbox Screen: Insert an interactive pet sandbox screen while assets render where users can practice calling, feeding, and positioning their companion before desktop spawn.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_behavior_sandbox", "home_intro"], "waiting": {"headline": "Your pet is coming to life", "show_progress": true}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Personality Wheel Friend Picker: Redesign the friend selection screen into a dynamic quadrant wheel spotlight showing trait previews, animation samples, and audio voice clips.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Spin to Choose Your Desktop Companion", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Express Companion Matchmaker Flow: Add a fast 3-question matchmaker quiz screen directly before path selection to auto-suggest the best companion type and path for the user.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_path_quiz", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "choose_path": {"headline": "Select Your Suggested Path or Browse All Options"}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Certificate Account Sync Reorder: Move sign-in to take place immediately after adoption certificate confirmation, securing pet configuration to the account before generation starts.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [sign_in, hint] Multi-Account Desktop Sync Conflict Warning: Display an explicit hint on the sign-in screen warning users to sign into their original account to prevent profile overwrites or missing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign into your existing pet account to restore active companions and prevent profile resets."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Live GPU Hardware Diagnostics Waiting Badge: Display active system rendering status and hardware acceleration badges on the waiting screen during generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "GPU Accelerated Render Active", "style": "highlight"}]}}
6: [adoption, copy] Custom Creation Quality Safety Guarantee Copy: Add clear copy on photo upload assuring users that lighting auto-enhancement and manual retouching options safeguard custom pet creation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"body": "Our smart engine automatically enhances photo lighting and proportions. You can fine-tune your companion anytime after spawn."}}
7: [home, notification] Desktop Taskbar Tray Spawn Notification Prompt: Add a system tray ready notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted immediately when their pet appears on desktop.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "body": "You can minimize this window. We will ping your system tray as soon as your pet lands on your screen."}}
8: [finish, layout] Interactive Docked Controls Banner Layout: Update the home intro screen to a full bleed layout showcasing visual shortcut banners for desktop controls, pet summoning, and tray settings.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Your Companion is Live on Desktop", "body": "Press Ctrl+Pet to summon, right-click the tray icon to adjust settings, or talk directly via voice mode."}}
9: [choose_path, incentive] Exclusive Companion Accessory Path Reward: Show a starter bonus accessory badge on path selection cards to incentivize early onboarding completion.
   config: {"choose_path": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Includes Free Starter Accessory Bundle", "style": "playful"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Valid addition of an interactive onboarding screen after waiting and before home intro.
Valid redesign of the friend selection screen while retaining its core function.
Valid addition of a matchmaker quiz screen prior to path selection.
Valid reordering of the sign-in step to occur after adoption certificate confirmation.
Valid informational hint added to the sign-in screen.
Valid update to information and status badges displayed on the waiting screen.
Valid instructional copy update on the photo upload screen.
Valid notification setting toggle added to the waiting screen.
Valid layout update to the home intro onboarding overlay.
Onboarding copy mentions free extras or bonuses ('Includes Free Starter Accessory Bundle').
